question: Under what temporal condition of practice does old age and death become destroyed?
premises: Practice is undertaken for one year.
That practice is performed when done in the stated manner.
Old age and death are destroyed as a result.
inference: When this practice has been performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The exact manner of practice is presupposed from preceding verses.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
